title: KPI Card
description: One headline number with its change and its trend, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Skeleton and SparkChart primitives: the metric's label and period, its value in the display face, its change tinted by whether that change is good news and a sparkline of the period, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the value and the sparkline side by side at @sm, a larger value and a wider sparkline at @md, the widest sparkline at @lg.
